_doc: Declarative UI states captured by scripts/ui/capture.mjs. Fields: id (kebab-case, unique), title, route (key of 'routes'), viewports (optional, default both), setup.localStorage (key -> value, objects are JSON-stringified; applied before the app loads), steps (click|fill|press|select|waitFor, run in order), requires (selector or text, or a list; checked AFTER the steps: when absent the state is SKIPPED, not failed, so old releases and old PRs still capture cleanly), waitFor (selector or text, or a list; must hold before the screenshot, failure is an error), caption. To show a new feature in every PR/release proof, append a state here. Titles and captions: letters, digits, spaces and . , : ; ' ( ) / + - only.
